name: Residencia Legal Temporaria -- Estudiante

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an official certificate from the educational institution confirming enrollment.
requirements.fix_path: Secure enrollment at a Uruguayan institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires proof of sufficient financial means for living expenses -- personal funds, family support (with documented kinship), or foreign remittances, notarially certified.

evidence_required.document: Notarized certification of financial means (personal, family, or foreign remittance)
Current vaccination certificate and health record

outcome.duration_length: 6 months to 2 years, renewable for equal periods

sources.title: Sitio oficial de la República Oriental del Uruguay -- Residencia Legal Temporaria: student-category evidence requirements

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Uruguay's initial build. Same underlying trámite as uy_temporary_residency_worker (Uruguay's general temporary residency), modelled as a separate route file here since the schema requires one category per route and 'study' and 'work_sponsored' are distinct categories. work_rights set 'none': the source does not describe employment authorisation under the student evidence pathway specifically.
